scope: Independent C++ ordering-setting lifecycle probes using supported SESSION syntax. Rust configuration support remains unimplemented.

cases.name: ordering_lifecycle
cases.sql: SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); SET default_null_order='nulls_first'; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); BEGIN; SET default_null_order='nulls_last'; ROLLBACK; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); SET SESSION default_null_order='nulls_first'; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); RESET default_null_order; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); RESET SESSION default_null_order; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); SET default_order='desc'; SELECT current_setting('default_order'); SELECT x FROM (VALUES (1),(NULL),(2)) t(x) ORDER BY x;

cases.name: session_default_falls_back_to_global
cases.sql: SET GLOBAL default_null_order='first'; SET SESSION default_null_order='last'; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); SET SESSION default_null_order=DEFAULT; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order'); RESET GLOBAL default_null_order; SELECT current_setting('default_null_order');

cases.name: direction_default
cases.sql: SELECT current_setting('default_order'); SET default_order='descending'; SELECT current_setting('default_order'); SET default_order=DEFAULT; SELECT current_setting('default_order');
